scope: One public AC1027 TABLECONTENT object whose typed parser reaches the first attributed cell and rejects the first ATTDEF handle-stream reference role.

source.fixturePolicy: The public sample remains outside the repository; no DWG or DXF fixture was added.

specification.title: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
specification.rule: After each cell-content payload, the attribute count is followed by ATTDEF handles encoded as soft pointers, then TV text and a BL index.

observedNextReference.targetRoleEvidence: The LibreDWG 0.14 paired DXF contains group 0 STYLE with group 5 handle 11 and no ATTDEF record with handle 11.

observedObject.sourceSpanStatus: unresolved; the observation may indicate prior body/string/handle offset drift and does not establish a producer deviation from ODA

currentMask01Recheck.followingState: The parser reads the cell custom-item count of 1 and linked-data state, then a cell-content CadValue with flags=6/type=4; the later attribute count is 208 and the first ATTDEF handle then fails its role check.

observations: The AC1027 TABLECONTENT dispatch resolves handle 0xC94, reads the 9-column and 20-row framing, and reaches row 0 cell 0.
The bounded role probe sees handle code 0x05/reference 0x11 where the current ATTDEF decoder requires code 0x04; parsing fails without publishing the TABLECONTENT typed callback.
libdxfrwTrace.instrumentation: The trace included temporary diagnostic logging in the handle-role probe; those source edits were reverted. Parser behavior and the observed values were unchanged by the diagnostic.

observations: The corrected ODA mask-0x01 rule consumes the cell custom-data flags=2/type=2 payload.
The first cell's one custom item and linked-data state parse; its cell-content CadValue is flags=6/type=4, after which the cell parse is incomplete at row 0/cell 0.
The previous bounded handle-role probe for this same source path observed code 0x05/reference 0x11 at the first ATTDEF slot.
At row 0/cell 0/content 0, the parser reads attribute count 208 at body bit 990 and string bit 18176.
The first ATTDEF handle begins at handle bit 115929; it decodes as hard-pointer code 0x05/reference 0x11 and ends at bit 115945, while ODA §20.4.97 requires soft-pointer code 0x04.
boundedHandleSpanProbe.instrumentation: Temporary diagnostic statements were reverted; behavior was unchanged.

observations: The source key ACAD_ROUNDTRIP_2008_CELL_CHECKSUM occupies string bits 17556..18094; its flags=2/type=2 custom value occupies body bits 840..928 and string bits 18094..18098.
The cell-content flags=6/type=4 CadValue occupies body bits 950..980 and string bits 18098..18176.
The immediately following attribute count ends at body bit 990 and is 208; the handle cursor is still bit 115929 before the first attribute reference.
bodyStringHandleSpanProbe.instrumentation: Temporary cursor/key DRW_DBG statements only; no parser behavior changed and all source edits were removed after capture.

libreDwgPeer.finding: The peer reports TABLECONTENT type 529 as an unknown class object and retains it as UNKNOWN_OBJ. Its DXF identifies handle 0x11 as STYLE, not ATTDEF, which confirms the current cursor points at an unrelated record; it does not independently decode this object's body span or identify the intended ATTDEF target.

handle11TargetCheck.evidence: Scanned entity/object DXF group-code pairs; record with group 0 STYLE has group 5 value 11, and no ATTDEF has group 5 value 11.

acadsSharp.result: DwgReader.Read() completes and exposes one TABLE entity at handle 0x4F2 with 20 rows and 9 columns; document.GetCadObject(0xC94) returns null.
acadsSharp.sourceRoute: DwgObjectReader.Entities.cs readTableContent is called by readTableEntity for embedded table data (lines 568, 744); no separate TABLECONTENT object dispatch was found.
acadsSharp.evidenceCeiling: This is not an independent decode of standalone object 0xC94 and does not adjudicate its body span or ATTDEF handle role.

implementationBoundary.currentBehavior: Keep the TABLECONTENT parse failed and the source frame incomplete; strict complete conversion remains refused.
implementationBoundary.prohibitedInference: Do not accept the observed hard-pointer role or reference 0x11 as an ATTDEF target, and do not adjust the expected role until preceding body/string/handle spans are reconciled.
implementationBoundary.nextWork: Reconcile the known custom-key/value, cell-value, attribute-count and handle spans against ODA for this exact source object; the first observed target is a STYLE, not ATTDEF. Obtain an independent decoder route for standalone type 529 before changing acceptance. Add a generated regression only after the exact wire profile is established.

doesNotEstablish: that handle 0x11 is the intended ATTDEF target
complete TABLECONTENT or AC1027 DWG support
native TABLE rendering or semantic equivalence
